grammar.pattern: 不 / 没 / 没有 · 别 + verb
grammar.purpose: Negate a habit, a past event or an instruction
grammar.explanation: 不 commonly negates a habit, intention or state: 我不喝奶; 房间不大. 没/没有 negates an event that did not happen: 昨天没上课. 没有 also means not have: 没有课. Do not use 不有. 别 gives a negative instruction: 别忘了. The choice is about meaning, not a rule that every past sentence contains 没.

examples.py: wǒ bù hē nǎi , zuó tiān yě méi hē .
examples.en: I do not drink milk and did not drink it yesterday either.

examples.zh: 星期日没有课，别去学校。
examples.py: xīng qī rì méi yǒu kè , bié qù xué xiào .
examples.en: There is no class on Sunday; do not go to school.

commonMistakes.why: 有 is negated with 没有, not 不有.

grammar.pattern: verb + 不 + verb · 有 + 没有
grammar.explanation: Repeat the verb around its negative: 去不去, 是不是; 有 uses 有没有. Two-syllable verbs can repeat fully or shorten the first part: 喜欢不喜欢 / 喜不喜欢. These questions already ask for a yes/no choice, so do not add 吗 in the same neutral question. Answer with the affirmative or negative verb; 是 is not a universal English-style yes.

dialogue.title: The wrong day
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the corrected class day and the plan after the mistake.

lines.zh: 今天是不是星期日？你去不去学校？
lines.py: jīn tiān shì bu shì xīng qī rì ? nǐ qù bù qù xué xiào ?
lines.en: Is today Sunday? Are you going to school?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 今天是星期六。你是不是记错了？
lines.py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī liù . nǐ shì bu shì jì cuò le ?
lines.en: Today is Saturday. Did you remember incorrectly?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对不起，我忘记星期几上课了。
lines.py: duì bu qǐ , wǒ wàng jì xīng qī jǐ shàng kè le .
lines.en: Sorry, I forgot which day class is.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没事儿。你先等一下，我看日历。
lines.py: méi shìr . nǐ xiān děng yī xià , wǒ kàn rì lì .
lines.en: It is okay. Wait a moment; I will check the calendar.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 前天有没有课？
lines.py: qián tiān yǒu méi yǒu kè ?
lines.en: Was there class the day before yesterday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有。星期日也没有课，明天别去学校。
lines.py: méi yǒu . xīng qī rì yě méi yǒu kè , míng tiān bié qù xué xiào .
lines.en: No. There is no class on Sunday either, so do not go to school tomorrow.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我记得去年星期日有课。
lines.py: wǒ jì de qù nián xīng qī rì yǒu kè .
lines.en: I remember having class on Sundays last year.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，今年改了。你学习汉语半年了吧？
lines.py: duì , jīn nián gǎi le . nǐ xué xí hàn yǔ bàn nián le ba ?
lines.en: Right, it changed this year. You have studied Chinese for half a year, right?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对，明年想去中国。我怕忘了时间。
lines.py: duì , míng nián xiǎng qù zhōng guó . wǒ pà wàng le shí jiān .
lines.en: Yes, I would like to go to China next year. I worry I will forget the time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你记星期一晚上七点就行。那间房不大，人不多。
lines.py: nǐ jì xīng qī yī wǎn shang qī diǎn jiù xíng . nà jiān fáng bù dà , rén bù duō .
lines.en: Note down Monday at seven in the evening. That room is small and there are not many people.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你明天有没有事？
lines.py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu méi yǒu shì ?
lines.en: Do you have anything to do tomorrow?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没什么事，我们在家读书吧。
lines.py: méi shén me shì , wǒ men zài jiā dú shū ba .
lines.en: Nothing much. Let us read at home.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Corrected group message
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find the date correction and the next class time.

lines.zh: 对不起，我刚才记错了，今天是星期六，不是星期日。
lines.py: duì bu qǐ , wǒ gāng cái jì cuò le , jīn tiān shì xīng qī liù , bù shì xīng qī rì .
lines.en: Sorry, I remembered incorrectly just now: today is Saturday, not Sunday.

lines.zh: 前天没有课，明天也没有课。
lines.py: qián tiān méi yǒu kè , míng tiān yě méi yǒu kè .
lines.en: There was no class the day before yesterday, and there is none tomorrow.

lines.zh: 去年星期日有课，今年改了，请别去错时间。
lines.py: qù nián xīng qī rì yǒu kè , jīn nián gǎi le , qǐng bié qù cuò shí jiān .
lines.en: Last year there was class on Sunday; it changed this year, so please do not go at the wrong time.

lines.zh: 你记星期一晚上七点，那间房不大，人不多。
lines.py: nǐ jì xīng qī yī wǎn shang qī diǎn , nà jiān fáng bù dà , rén bù duō .
lines.en: Note Monday at seven in the evening; the room is small and there are not many people.

lines.zh: 我学习汉语半年了，明年想去中国。
lines.py: wǒ xué xí hàn yǔ bàn nián le , míng nián xiǎng qù zhōng guó .
lines.en: I have studied Chinese for half a year and would like to go to China next year.

lines.zh: 我记得要学习，也怕忘记时间。请你下次再告诉我。
lines.py: wǒ jì de yào xué xí , yě pà wàng jì shí jiān . qǐng nǐ xià cì zài gào sù wǒ .
lines.en: I remember to study but worry I will forget the time; please tell me again next time.

lines.zh: 明天有没有事？没什么事的话，我们在家读书。
lines.py: míng tiān yǒu méi yǒu shì ? méi shén me shì de huà , wǒ men zài jiā dú shū .
lines.en: Do you have anything to do tomorrow? If there is nothing much, let us read at home.

lines.zh: 没事儿，今天不用等老师，明天也别等。
lines.py: méi shìr , jīn tiān bù yòng děng lǎo shī , míng tiān yě bié děng .
lines.en: It is okay. There is no need to wait for the teacher today or tomorrow.

lines.zh: 记星期几？星期六。是不是星期日？不是。
lines.py: jì xīng qī jǐ ? xīng qī liù . shì bu shì xīng qī rì ? bù shì .
lines.en: Which day to note? Saturday. Is it Sunday? No.

lines.zh: 前天没有课，明天也没有，别等老师。
lines.py: qián tiān méi yǒu kè , míng tiān yě méi yǒu , bié děng lǎo shī .
lines.en: No class the day before yesterday, none tomorrow; do not wait for the teacher.

lines.zh: 对不起，忘记了。没事儿，再记一次。
lines.py: duì bu qǐ , wàng jì le . méi shìr , zài jì yī cì .
lines.en: Sorry, I forgot. It is okay; note it once more.

lines.zh: 去年到今年，半年学习，明年还想去中国。
lines.py: qù nián dào jīn nián , bàn nián xué xí , míng nián hái xiǎng qù zhōng guó .
lines.en: From last year to this year, half a year studying; next year I still want to go to China.

lines.zh: 那间房不大，星期一七点，别忘时间。
lines.py: nà jiān fáng bù dà , xīng qī yī qī diǎn , bié wàng shí jiān .
lines.en: The room is small; Monday at seven—do not forget the time.

lines.zh: 明天没什么事，在家读书，先不等。
lines.py: míng tiān méi shén me shì , zài jiā dú shū , xiān bù děng .
lines.en: Nothing much tomorrow; read at home rather than wait.
